description: This file implements the tinyRoam module for Access Point (AP) roaming management, including functions for initiating, handling, and stopping roaming attempts, as well as callback management and internal state tracking.

classes.name: wld_tinyRoam
classes.description: Structure managing the state and parameters for a roaming attempt, including attempt limits, timers, target BSSID, and callback functions.

methods.name: wld_tinyRoam_targetBssid
methods.description: Returns the BSSID the tinyRoam module is trying to roam to, or null if not roaming.

methods.name: wld_tinyRoam_isRoaming
methods.description: Checks if a given endpoint is currently in the process of roaming.

methods.name: wld_tinyRoam_roamTo
methods.description: Initiates a roaming attempt to a specified BSSID with given parameters, setting up retries and callbacks.

methods.name: wld_tinyRoam_init
methods.description: Initializes the tinyRoam module for a specific endpoint, setting up event callbacks.

methods.name: wld_tinyRoam_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up resources allocated for tinyRoam on an endpoint, removing callbacks and freeing memory.
